settings.name: ttc_s
settings.rationale: FHWA SSAM chapter 2 starting point; fixed-heading projection transfer remains unvalidated.

settings.name: proximity_m
settings.rationale: Descriptive footprint clearance, not a stand-alone near-miss criterion.

settings.name: deceleration_mps2
settings.rationale: Strict exceedance, with speed and control gates; experimental until validated.

settings.name: braking_speed_mps
settings.rationale: Pre-event speed must strictly exceed this value.

settings.name: stationary_speed_mps
settings.rationale: Descriptive immobilization only; does not establish unjustified waiting.

settings.name: immobilization_s
settings.rationale: Continuous sampled stationary interval; inclusive duration threshold.

settings.name: collision_gap_s
settings.rationale: Maximum gap between same-actor callbacks grouped into one contact episode.

settings.name: encounter_rearm_s
settings.rationale: Continuous observed no-conflict, non-close interval required to close an encounter.

settings.name: braking_duration_s
settings.rationale: Observed span of qualifying samples; no extrapolation before first sample.

settings.name: projection_horizon_s
settings.rationale: Fixed-heading, constant horizontal velocity projection; vertically static actors only.

settings.name: scan_radius_m
settings.rationale: Declared observation domain only; does not establish absence outside this radius.

settings.name: max_sample_interval_s
settings.rationale: Allows nominal 10 Hz plus numeric tolerance; larger gaps censor episodes.

settings.name: minimum_observation_s
settings.rationale: Minimum complete interval for negative descriptive assessments.

settings.name: task_window_s
settings.rationale: Continuous eligible observation window for lack of new route progress; legitimate waits excluded.

settings.name: progress_epsilon_m
settings.rationale: Maximum advance in route high-water arc length over the task window to qualify as no progress.

settings.name: quality_min_observation_s
settings.rationale: Minimum complete evaluation interval for the low-interaction proxy; not a triviality certificate.

settings.name: interaction_radius_m
settings.rationale: Nearby footprint clearance defines an interaction opportunity, supplemented by predicted contact within the horizon; includes safe interactions.

settings.name: hazard_braking_antecedent_s
settings.rationale: Fixed antecedent window linking commanded hard braking to an observed predicted-conflict encounter (excluding passive parallel proximity); observational association only, never causal proof.

settings.name: speeding_tolerance_mps
settings.rationale: Speed excess above declared map speed limit (~3.6 km/h) before qualifying as speeding; requires explicit map speed limit.

settings.name: speeding_duration_s
settings.rationale: Continuous observed interval above speed limit plus tolerance to prevent single-frame limit-transition spikes.

settings.name: stop_sign_speed_mps
settings.rationale: Maximum ego speed counted as coming to a stop inside an applicable stop-sign approach zone.

settings.name: stop_sign_dwell_s
settings.rationale: Minimum continuous low-speed dwell inside an applicable stop-sign approach zone before crossing the stop line.

settings.name: wrong_way_speed_mps
settings.rationale: Minimum opposing velocity component along a lane's permitted travel direction (excluding legal reverse and junctions).

settings.name: wrong_way_duration_s
settings.rationale: Continuous observed interval of opposing travel required for wrong-way assessment.
